text:
caroline: Hey team — I pushed a docs PR with compact SDK examples that unify streaming + pagination backpressure knobs for py/ts/go. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 This is driven by the low-latency use case we saw in the PLG demo. Can someone sanity-check the snippets?
ben: taking a look now. Quick Q: do we want to show both cursor resume and lease-based TTL cache in the examples or pick one?
dmitri: prefer single pattern to avoid docs churn. favor cursor resume + N-prefetch + per-request deadline.
alice: ack. for TS example I'd show AbortSignal + small batch size. for py show async iterator + asyncio.wait_for.
ben: updated the TS snippet to use AbortController and a small buffer. snippet: ```ts
const ac = new AbortController();
const s = client.responses.stream({model: 'redwood-mini', input: q, signal: ac.signal});
for await (const part of s) { handle(part); if (latencyNice()) ac.abort(); }
```
caroline: thanks — looks good. For Go can we show context.WithTimeout + a resume-token in headers?
dmitri: added go snippet: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 250*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
resp, _ := client.StreamResponses(ctx, req)
for resp.Next() { process(resp.Event) }
```
caroline: small docs nit — the pagination example currently uses `cursor: null` and then later `cursor: ""` in different snippets. Can we normalize to `cursor: ""` and call it out in a note?
ben: fixed in PR and added a short note under "Resume tokens" explaining empty string = start.
docs-bot: PR 482 updated: added tests for snippet compilation and CI linting passed.
alice: one more runtime suggestion — add a matrix table (tiny) that maps knobs to expected effect: batching -> throughput up, latency down (if batch-size small) ; TTL cache -> cold-start reduction. Keep it inline, not a separate page.
caroline: done — I added a compact "knob matrix" under the examples section and a one-paragraph migration note for anyone upgrading from v1 snippets.
dmitri: thumbs up. merging in 30m unless someone objects. :thumbsup: 
ben: lgtm
alice: lgtm
caroline: thanks everyone, will watch the release bot and open follow-up if users report confusion.
